name: Driving instruction
what: Hold a licence or accreditation from the state transport agency to give driving lessons for reward.
consistency_note: Each state and territory licenses driving instructors under its own road transport law.

basis.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
basis.quote: You will need this accreditation if you intend to offer driving lessons.

basis.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
basis.quote: 6 Unlicensed driving instruction A person must not act as a driving instructor unless the person is the holder of a licence.

basis.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
basis.quote: You will need this endorsement if you intend to work as a driving instructor.
